name: 555 timers
summary: The classic timer chip for oscillators, delays, flashers and simple PWM.
uses: Simple motor speed or LED dimmer (PWM)
identify: 8-pin chip marked NE555, LM555 or similar (the 556 is a dual, 14 pins). Found in older alarms, flashers, toys, timers and simple controllers.
test: Fit it into a basic flasher circuit: a flashing LED means it works. Out of circuit only obvious damage shows.
